name: regula
display_name: Regula — EU AI Act Code-Indicator Scanner
description: Report code-observable AI governance indicators and candidate risk categories for contextual human review. Maps findings to 13 framework references and provides review scaffolds. The core install has no required third-party runtime dependencies; optional features may add dependencies or network access.

install.instructions: Install via pipx: `pipx install regula-ai`. Run: `regula mcp-server` or `python3 scripts/mcp_server.py`.

tools.name: regula_check
tools.description: Scan a project for code-observable AI-governance indicators. Candidate risk categories require contextual human review and are not legal classification or compliance determinations.

tools.name: regula_classify
tools.description: Report candidate EU AI Act risk-category indicators in a code snippet for contextual human review. The command name is a technical API identifier, not a legal classification.

tools.name: regula_gap
tools.description: Report code-observable gaps against an Articles 9-15 review scaffold. Results require human completion and do not determine compliance.
